name: asic-tools
description: Agent-harness tooling for Claude Code + Warp. PRP lifecycle: idea-refine (upstream ideation one-pager), draft-prp (research-first PRP generator), prp-review (adversarial 6-lens review gate), and prp-implement (two-phase drift-checked executor). Plus asicdash (config + usage dashboard: audit visible and invisible config, Claude usage heatmap), scaffold (standards-enforced Python bootstrap), release (multi-location version bump + changelog), and sync-rules (deploy the bundled global engineering rules to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md).
